mapper.sql: FROM SLS_TB s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT QUO_YM, QUO_SEQ, SUM(NET_SALES) NET_SALES FROM TEST_ITEM_TB WHERE STATE <> 'D' GROUP BY QUO_YM, QUO_SEQ ) items ON s.QUO_YM = items.QUO_YM AND s.QUO_SEQ = items.QUO_SEQ LEFT JOIN QUO_TB qchq ON IFNULL(s.QUO_SEQ, 0) = 0 AND s.CHQ_YM = qchq.CHQ_YM AND s.CHQ_SEQ = qchq.CHQ_SEQ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT QUO_YM, QUO_SEQ, SUM(NET_SALES) NET_SALES FROM TEST_ITEM_TB WHERE STATE <> 'D' GROUP BY QUO_YM, QUO_SEQ ) items2 ON qchq.QUO_YM = items2.QUO_YM AND qchq.QUO_SEQ = items2.QUO_SEQ

DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(IFNULL(b.OTHER_BILL_DT, b.BILL_DT)) FROM BILL_TB b WHERE b.SLS_YM = s.SLS_YM AND b.SLS_SEQ = s.SLS_SEQ AND b.BILL_YN = 1 AND b.STATE NOT IN (4, 6)), s.CNFRM_DT, s.INS_DT ))
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(JAN+FEB+MAR+APR+MAY+JUN+JUL+AUG+SEP+OCT+NOV+`DEC`), 0), 0) AS yearTargetMan, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(CASE MONTH(CURDATE()) WHEN 1 THEN JAN WHEN 2 THEN FEB WHEN 3 THEN MAR WHEN 4 THEN APR WHEN 5 THEN MAY WHEN 6 THEN JUN WHEN 7 THEN JUL WHEN 8 THEN AUG WHEN 9 THEN SEP WHEN 10 THEN OCT WHEN 11 THEN NOV WHEN 12 THEN `DEC` END), 0), 0) AS monthTargetMan, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(JAN),0),0) AS m1, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(FEB),0),0) AS m2, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(MAR),0),0) AS m3, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(APR),0),0) AS m4, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(MAY),0),0) AS m5, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(JUN),0),0) AS m6, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(JUL),0),0) AS m7, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(AUG),0),0) AS m8, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(SEP),0),0) AS m9, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(OCT),0),0) AS m10, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(NOV),0),0) AS m11, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(`DEC`),0),0) AS m12 FROM TARGET_TB t INNER JOIN MEMBER_TB m ON m.ID = t.MEM_ID AND m.MNG_YN = 1 WHERE t.YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE())

SELECT IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(YEAR(s.END_DT)=YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(s.END_DT)=MONTH(CURDATE()), , 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS monthActualMan, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(YEAR(s.END_DT)=YEAR(CURDATE()), , 0)) / 10000, 0), 0) AS yearActualMan
WHERE s.STATE <> 'D' AND s.ARREARS = 0

SELECT IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(x.ARREARS)/10000, 0), 0) AS arrearsMan, COUNT(*) AS arrearsCnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(x.d < 30, x.ARREARS, 0))/10000, 0), 0) AS d30Man, IFNULL(SUM(IF(x.d < 30, 1, 0)), 0) AS d30Cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(x.d >= 30 AND x.d < 60, x.ARREARS, 0))/10000, 0), 0) AS d60Man, IFNULL(SUM(IF(x.d >= 30 AND x.d < 60, 1, 0)), 0) AS d60Cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(x.d >= 60 AND x.d < 90, x.ARREARS, 0))/10000, 0), 0) AS d90Man, IFNULL(SUM(IF(x.d >= 60 AND x.d < 90, 1, 0)), 0) AS d90Cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(IF(x.d >= 90, x.ARREARS, 0))/10000, 0), 0) AS d90pMan, IFNULL(SUM(IF(x.d >= 90, 1, 0)), 0) AS d90pCnt FROM ( SELECT s.ARREARS, AS d FROM SLS_TB s WHERE s.STATE <> 'D' AND s.ARREARS > 0 AND ) x
mapper.sql: IFNULL(COALESCE( NULLIF(s.SLS_TOTAL, 0), (SELECT q.TOTAL_VAT FROM QUO_TB q WHERE q.QUO_YM = s.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = s.QUO_SEQ AND q.STATE <> 'D' LIMIT 1), 0 ), 0) > 0

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUO_TB qbill INNER JOIN SLS_TB s ON s.STATE <> 'D' AND ( (s.QUO_YM = qbill.QUO_YM AND s.QUO_SEQ = qbill.QUO_SEQ) OR ( IFNULL(qbill.CHQ_SEQ, 0) <> 0 AND s.CHQ_YM = qbill.CHQ_YM AND s.CHQ_SEQ = qbill.CHQ_SEQ ) ) INNER JOIN BILL_TB b ON b.SLS_YM = s.SLS_YM AND b.SLS_SEQ = s.SLS_SEQ AND b.BILL_YN = 1 AND b.STATE NOT IN (4, 6) WHERE qbill.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND qbill.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(ti.NET_SALES)/10000, 0), 0) AS amtMan FROM TEST_TB t INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ AND j.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ WHERE t.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18 AND YEAR(t.TEST_STATE_DT) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND IFNULL(q.TOTAL_VAT, 0) > 0 AND NOT
SELECT IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(BILL)/10000, 0), 0) FROM BILL_TB WHERE PAY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND STATE NOT IN (4, 6) AND YEARWEEK(PAY_DT, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM(ti.NET_SALES)/10000, 0), 0) AS amtMan FROM TEST_TB t INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' WHERE t.TEST_STATE_CODE IN (3, 4, 5) AND t.INS_DT BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR) AND NOW()

SELECT FN_GET_SEQSTRING('M', s.SLS_YM, '', s.SLS_SEQ) AS slsId, IFNULL(COALESCE(j.CMPY_NAME, jchq.CMPY_NAME), '') AS cmpyName, IFNULL(FN_MEM_NAME(COALESCE(j.MNG_ID, jchq.MNG_ID)), '-') AS mngName, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(s.ARREARS/10000, 0), 0) AS arrearsMan, AS days FROM SLS_TB s LEFT JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = s.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = s.QUO_SEQ AND j.STATE <> 'D' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.CHQ_YM, q.CHQ_SEQ, MAX(j2.CMPY_NAME) AS CMPY_NAME, MAX(j2.MNG_ID) AS MNG_ID FROM QUO_TB q INNER JOIN JOB_TB j2 ON j2.QUO_YM = q.QUO_YM AND j2.QUO_SEQ = q.QUO_SEQ AND j2.STATE <> 'D' WHERE IFNULL(q.CHQ_SEQ, 0) <> 0 GROUP BY q.CHQ_YM, q.CHQ_SEQ ) jchq ON IFNULL(s.QUO_SEQ, 0) = 0 AND jchq.CHQ_YM = s.CHQ_YM AND jchq.CHQ_SEQ = s.CHQ_SEQ WHERE s.STATE <> 'D' AND s.ARREARS > 0 AND ORDER BY days DESC, s.ARREARS DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT CONCAT( 'SB', j.SBK_YM, '-', j.SBK_TYPE, LPAD(j.SBK_SEQ, 4, 0), '-', IF(t.TEST_TYPE_CODE = 'NS', 'SF', t.TEST_TYPE_CODE), LPAD(t.TEST_NO, 4, 0) ) AS testId, FN_GET_SEQSTRING('Q', q.QUO_YM, q.TYPE, q.QUO_SEQ) AS quoId, IFNULL(j.CMPY_NAME, '') AS cmpyName, IFNULL(FN_MEM_NAME(j.MNG_ID), '-') AS mngName, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(ti.NET_SALES/10000, 0), 0) AS netMan, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), t.TEST_STATE_DT) AS days, DATE_FORMAT(t.TEST_STATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt FROM TEST_TB t INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ AND j.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ WHERE t.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18 AND YEAR(t.TEST_STATE_DT) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND IFNULL(q.TOTAL_VAT, 0) > 0 AND NOT ORDER BY t.TEST_STATE_DT LIMIT 30

SELECT m.ID AS memId, m.MEM_NAME AS memName, IFNULL(t.JAN,0) AS m1, IFNULL(t.FEB,0) AS m2, IFNULL(t.MAR,0) AS m3, IFNULL(t.APR,0) AS m4, IFNULL(t.MAY,0) AS m5, IFNULL(t.JUN,0) AS m6, IFNULL(t.JUL,0) AS m7, IFNULL(t.AUG,0) AS m8, IFNULL(t.SEP,0) AS m9, IFNULL(t.OCT,0) AS m10, IFNULL(t.NOV,0) AS m11, IFNULL(t.`DEC`,0) AS m12, IFNULL(act.yearActualMan, 0) AS yearActualMan FROM TARGET_TB t INNER JOIN MEMBER_TB m ON m.ID = t.MEM_ID AND m.MNG_YN = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT j.MNG_ID, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(SUM()/10000, 0), 0) AS yearActualMan
INNER JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = s.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = s.QUO_SEQ AND j.STATE <> 'D' WHERE s.STATE <> 'D' AND s.ARREARS = 0 AND YEAR(s.END_DT) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY j.MNG_ID ) act ON act.MNG_ID = m.ID WHERE t.YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND (t.JAN+t.FEB+t.MAR+t.APR+t.MAY+t.JUN+t.JUL+t.AUG+t.SEP+t.OCT+t.NOV+t.`DEC`) > 0
